# Delta Dental

> Comprehensive dental insurance provider offering individual, family, and group plans with member resources, provider tools, and wellness support across multiple states.

Delta Dental operates multiple plan types including PPO, DHMO, and DeltaCare USA coverage, serving members and dental providers across the United States. The platform provides member portals, dentist networks, continuing education, and practice management tools.

## Key Topics

- Delta Dental PPO
- DeltaCare USA
- Delta Dental Premier
- Dental Benefits
- Member Portal
- Provider Tools
- Find Dentist Network
- Preventive Care
- Claims Processing
- Group Dental Plans
- Individual Plans
- Provider Recruitment
- Continuing Education
- Multi-Factor Authentication
- Medicare Advantage

## Individual & Family Plans

- [Plans for individuals and groups](https://www1.deltadentalins.com): Delta Dental homepage with individual, family, and group dental plans
- [Individual and Family Dental Plans](https://www1.deltadentalins.com/individuals-and-families.html): Individual and family dental plan options including PPO and DHMO coverage
- [Employer Dental Insurance Plans](https://www1.deltadentalins.com/employers.html): Customizable group dental insurance plans for employers and employees

## Member Resources & Support

- [Member resources](https://www1.deltadentalins.com/members.html): Central hub for member portal access, benefits, and dental resources
- [Find a dentist for members](https://www1.deltadentalins.com/find-a-dentist-members.html): Member tool to search dentist networks across Delta Dental plan types
- [Member FAQs](https://www1.deltadentalins.com/faqs/members.html): Frequently asked questions about member accounts, coverage, and benefits
- [Member perks](https://www1.deltadentalins.com/memberperks.html): Member discounts and wellness benefits including vision and hearing services
- [Language assistance](https://www1.deltadentalins.com/members/language-assistance.html): Language Assistance Program providing free interpretation for members

## Provider Network & Recruitment

- [Delta Dental for Dentists](https://www1.deltadentalins.com/dentists.html): Provider information for dentists joining Delta Dental network
- [Join the network](https://www1.deltadentalins.com/dentists/join.html): Dentist recruitment and network enrollment for multiple plan types
- [Dentist FAQs](https://www1.deltadentalins.com/faqs/dentists.html): Provider FAQs covering claims, tools, and practice optimization

## Provider Tools & Practice Resources

- [Provider Tools: Simplifying Dental Practice](https://www1.deltadentalins.com/dentists/provider-tools.html): Provider tools, webinars, and resources for dental practice management
- [Dental office resources](https://www1.deltadentalins.com/dentists/resources.html): Administrative resources for dental offices including credentialing and forms
- [Dental Continuing Education](https://www1.deltadentalins.com/dentists/resources/training-and-events.html): Continuing education courses and webinars for dental professionals

## Health & Wellness

- [Healthy Living Hub](https://www1.deltadentalins.com/wellness.html): Preventive care articles, health awareness resources, and dental education

## Optional

- [Contact Our Offices](https://www1.deltadentalins.com/about/contact.html): Delta Dental office locations and contact information for customer support
- [Health Care Exchange (Marketplace) for Dentists](https://www1.deltadentalins.com/dentists/health-care-exchange.html): Guide to ACA Marketplace dental coverage for dental providers
